title: 第5章 娶妻的想法第6章 偏心爹娘的算计
slug: 玄幻苟在深山打猎开局弟妹上门求肉
lines: 王大山闷哼一声，体内发出阵阵雷鸣。
每一寸肌肉，每一块骨头，都在贪婪地吸收着这股药力。
不知过了多久。
他猛的睁开眼睛，眼底透着一股摄人的精光。
张开嘴，缓缓吐出一口浊气。
凝而不散，如同一支白箭，直直地喷出半米多远，撞在虚空中。
“吐气如箭！”
“这是气血境强者的标志！”
王大山低下头，试着握了握拳。
一股巨力从掌心涌现，仿佛只要他愿意，甚至能开山断江。
但他知道，这是刚刚突破的错觉。
他随手对着空气挥了一拳。
拳风呼啸，带起一阵劲风，吹得桌上的烛火一阵摇曳。
“估计现在我一拳下去，都能直接打死一头牛了吧。”
王大山忍不住笑了出来。
这种掌控力量的感觉，实在是太让人着迷了。
难怪这个世界上的人，挤破了头都想练武。
因为只有成了武者，命运才能掌握在自己手里。
就在这时。
王大山的脑海众，突然涌出一股陌生的记忆。
这记忆，是关于武者第一境的修炼之法，以及如何调动体内气血的窍门。
原身记忆许久，天天苦练带来的本能。
“呼呼呼……”
王大山下意识盘好腿，摆出一个五心朝天的姿势。
按照脑海中的法门，开始调整呼吸。
三长两短。
吸气如鲸吞，呼气如抽丝。
随着呼吸节奏的改变，他体内的血液流速再次加快。
也变得粘稠了起来，如同滚雷炸响。
心脏跳动的声音强劲有力，如同擂鼓一般，在安静的房间里清晰可闻。
每一次跳动，都将沸腾的血液输送到全身各处。
周身的毛孔仿佛都在这一刻张开，贪婪地吞噬着周围稀薄的天地灵气。
过了好一会儿。
content_en:
"Yeah."
Wang Dashan groaned, and bursts of thunder erupted from his body.
Every inch of muscle and every bone is greedily absorbing the power of this medicine.
I don’t know how much time passed.
He opened his eyes suddenly, and there was a fascinating light in his eyes.
"Phew!"
Open your mouth and slowly exhale a breath.
It condensed but never dispersed, like a white arrow, shooting out more than half a meter away and hitting the void.
"Exhale like an arrow!"
"This is the sign of a strong person in the Qi and Blood Realm!"
Wang Dashan lowered his head and tried to make a fist.
A huge force emerged from the palm of his hand, as if he could even break mountains and rivers if he wanted to.
But he knew that this was an illusion that had just been broken through.
He casually punched the air.
"Boom!"
The fist wind roared, bringing up a strong wind that caused the candlelight on the table to sway.
"I guess now I can kill a cow with just one punch."
Wang Dashan couldn't help laughing.
This feeling of controlling power is so fascinating.
No wonder people in this world are desperate to practice martial arts.
Because only by becoming a warrior can your destiny be in your own hands.
Just then.
Wang Dashan's mind suddenly flooded with unfamiliar memories.
This memory is about the cultivation method of the first realm of warriors and the tips on how to mobilize the qi and blood in the body.
The original body has long-term memory and the instinct brought about by hard training every day.
"Huhuhu..."
Wang Dashan subconsciously crossed his legs and assumed a posture with five hearts in the sky.
Follow the method in your mind and start adjusting your breathing.
Three long and two short.
Inhale like a whale swallowing, exhale like a thread.
As the breathing rhythm changed, the blood flow in his body increased again.
It also became sticky, like rolling thunder and exploding.
"Boom! Boom! Boom!"
The sound of the beating heart was strong and powerful, like a drum, and could be heard clearly in the quiet room.
Every beat sends boiling blood to all parts of the body.
The pores all over his body seemed to open at this moment, greedily devouring the thin spiritual energy of heaven and earth around him.
After a while.
